description_en: This Procedure defines the mechanism of interaction of: the national cyber incident, cyberattack and cyber threat response team (CERT-UA) with law enforcement, intelligence and counterintelligence agencies and entities conducting operational and investigative activities; sectoral and regional cyber incident, cyberattack and cyber threat response teams (CSIRT) with law enforcement, intelligence and counterintelligence agencies, entities conducting operational and investigative activities, and other actors of the national system for responding to cyber incidents, cyberattacks and cyber threats; the National Police and the SBU with other actors of the national system for responding to cyber incidents, cyberattacks and cyber threats.

title_en: On Approval of the Procedure for Appointing a Head of Cyber Protection to a Position in a State Authority
description_en: This Procedure defines the procedure for appointing a head of cyber protection to a position in a state authority that owns or manages information, electronic communication and information and communication systems processing state information resources or official information and information constituting a state secret, and applies insofar as it does not contradict the Law of Ukraine "On Civil Service". The head of cyber protection in a state authority directs, coordinates and controls cyber protection and information protection matters of that state authority. The head of cyber protection may not be the official responsible for digital development, digital transformation and digitalization in the state authority. The cyber protection unit of the state authority reports to the head of cyber protection.

Certain Issues of Responding to Cyber Incidents, Cyberattacks and Cyber Threats
description_en: This order replaces the previous 2023 recommendations and introduces a modern risk-based approach built on European standards and international best practices. The new regulatory framework is intended not merely to update terminology but to shift the focus from purely reactive actions to proactive risk management. That is why work with cyber threats has been added to the familiar concepts of cyber incidents and cyberattacks. This makes it possible to detect and neutralize danger before it causes real harm to systems and networks.

title_en: On Approval of the Recommendations on Cyber Protection of Information and Communication Systems Using Artificial Intelligence Technologies
description_en: The document is intended as practical guidance for owners and managers of state and private information, electronic communication and technological systems. The recommendations are voluntary and are intended for use in developing cyber protection plans and assessing risks when introducing AI technologies. The document offers a comprehensive approach to the secure introduction of AI, details a taxonomy of cyber threats specific to such systems, and sets out steps to neutralize them.

title_en: Certain Issues of Operational and Technical Management of Electronic Communication Networks in Conditions of Emergency, State of Emergency or Martial Law
description_en: This Procedure defines the measures to prepare public electronic communication networks for operation in conditions of emergency, state of emergency or martial law, the mechanisms of their operational and technical management, the powers of the actors of the system of operational and technical management of public electronic communication networks and the conditions of their interaction in providing electronic communication services for national defense and security purposes in such conditions, and the scope and deadlines for submission of information by providers of electronic communication networks and/or services about the networks they operate to the National Center for Operational and Technical Management of Electronic Communication Networks of Ukraine.

The order establishes the procedure for providing and using electronic identification and electronic trust services in information and communication systems processing official information and state secrets.

title_en: Procedure for Confirmation by Suppliers of Goods, Works and Services of the Conformity of Implemented Information Security Measures with the Established Requirements According to the Level of Risk Associated with Supplying Goods, Works and Services to Owners or Managers of Information and Communication Systems Processing State Information Resources or Official Information and Information Constituting a State Secret, and of Critical Information Infrastructure Objects
description_en: This Procedure establishes the process by which suppliers of goods, works and services confirm the conformity of implemented information security measures with the established requirements according to the level of risk associated with supplying goods, works and services to owners or managers of information and communication systems processing state information resources or official information and information constituting a state secret, and of critical information infrastructure objects.

title_en: On Approval of the Methodological Recommendations for the Collection and Processing of Statistical Data on Cyberattacks, Cyber Incidents and Countermeasures at the State Service of Special Communications and Information Protection of Ukraine
description_en: The purpose of processing cyber statistics data is to summarize and publish cyber statistics data and to prepare reports for the target user group and for publication. Cyber statistics data are collected and processed by the State Cyber Protection Center of the State Service of Special Communications and Information Protection of Ukraine.

title_en: On Approval of the Procedure for Monitoring the Security Authorization of Information, Electronic Communication, Information and Communication, and Technological Systems
description_en: The document establishes a clear mechanism for controlling the security status of information, electronic communication, information and communication, and technological systems. It concerns systems that are included in the list of authorized systems and belong to critical information infrastructure objects or process data whose protection is guaranteed by law.

title_en: Certain Issues of Conducting Cyber Protection Status Assessments
description_en: Methodological recommendations for self-assessment of the current state of cyber protection; Methodological recommendations for external assessment of the current state of cyber protection; form of the report on the results of the cyber protection status assessment; Methodological recommendations for preparing the report on the results of the cyber protection status assessment.

title_en: On Approval of the Procedure for Maintaining the Cyber Incident Information Repository
description_en: This Procedure defines the purpose, functioning mechanism and maintenance of the cyber incident information repository

title_en: On Approval of the Regulation on Organizing the Uninterrupted Functioning of the Banking System of Ukraine, and the Activities of Non-Bank Financial Institutions and Other Persons That Are Not Financial Institutions but Are Entitled to Provide Certain Financial Services, Regulated and Supervised by the National Bank of Ukraine, During a Special Period
description_en: This Regulation [..] defines the specifics of their functioning and activities, as well as of the National Bank's supervision of their activities, in the event of a special period.

title_en: On Approval of the Cybersecurity Risk Assessment Methodology
description_en: This Methodology establishes a unified approach to identifying and assessing cybersecurity risks for state authorities, other state bodies, local self-government bodies, and state enterprises, institutions and organizations that own or manage information, electronic communication, information and communication, and technological systems processing state information resources or restricted information whose protection is required by law, as well as for critical infrastructure operators and owners or managers of critical information infrastructure objects, and is applied when establishing the current and/or target cyber protection states and developing cyber protection plans.

title_en: On Approval of the Procedure for Interaction of Sectoral and Regional Cyber Incident, Cyberattack and Cyber Threat Response Teams (CSIRT) with the National Cyber Incident, Cyberattack and Cyber Threat Response Team (CERT-UA), and of Private Cyber Incident, Cyberattack and Cyber Threat Response Teams with Other Actors of the National System for Responding to Cyber Incidents, Cyberattacks and Cyber Threats
description_en: This Procedure defines the mechanism of interaction of: sectoral and regional cyber incident, cyberattack and cyber threat response teams with the national cyber incident, cyberattack and cyber threat response team; private cyber incident, cyberattack and cyber threat response teams with other actors of the national system for responding to cyber incidents, cyberattacks and cyber threats.

title_en: On Approval of the Procedure for Connecting Cybersecurity Actors to the Platform for Exchanging Information on Cyber Incidents, Cyberattacks and Cyber Threats
description_en: This Procedure defines the mechanism and conditions for connecting to the platform for exchanging information on cyber incidents, cyberattacks and cyber threats the main actors of the national cybersecurity system, actors of the national response system, state authorities, state bodies, local self-government bodies, critical infrastructure operators, owners or managers of critical information infrastructure objects, and other cybersecurity actors that, in accordance with legislation, are involved in performing tasks within the functioning of the national response system

title_en: Certain Issues of the National Informatization Program
description_en: Regulation on the formation and implementation of the National Informatization Program; Procedure for the expert review of the National Informatization Program and its components; Procedure for the formation and implementation of a sectoral informatization program, project and works; Procedure for the formation and implementation of a regional informatization program, project and works; Procedure for monitoring and evaluating the effectiveness of implementation of the National Informatization Program and its components.

title_en: On Approval of the Requirements for Cyber Protection Status Assessment Entities
description_en: The Requirements contain a set of qualification and other mandatory conditions and criteria that legal entities, individual entrepreneurs or individuals conducting cyber protection status assessments must meet.
